passive.name: Rage Gene
passive.description: While in combat Gnar generates Rage. At maximum Rage his next ability will transform him into Mega Gnar, granting increased survivability and access to new spells.

spells.name: Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss
spells.description: Mini Gnar: Gnar throws a boomerang that deals physical damage and Slows by % for seconds. The boomerang returns after hitting an enemy, dealing reduced damage to subsequent targets. Each enemy can only be hit once. Catching the boomerang reduces its Cooldown by %.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation MiniTotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Hyper / Wallop
spells.description: Mini Gnar Passive: Every third Attack or Ability on the same enemy deals an additional plus % max Health magic damage and grants % Move Speed decaying over seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation MiniTotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Hop / Crunch
spells.description: Mini Gnar: Gnar leaps, gaining % Attack Speed for seconds. If Gnar lands on a unit he will bounce off it, traveling further. Bouncing off an enemy deals physical damage and briefly Slows by %.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation MiniTotalDamage was normalized. Unresolved parts: ChampionStat:12.

spells.name: GNAR!
spells.description: Mini Gnar Passive: Increase Hyper's Move Speed. Mega Gnar: Gnar tosses nearby enemies, dealing physical damage, Knocking Back, and Slowing them by % for seconds. Enemies that hit a wall instead take physical damage and are Stunned.
